notes.title: Update notes for 6 September 2021
notes.notes:
Now there is a black overlay when you start, which masks everything except the button you need to press.  (Thank you, Scott!)

We also corrected the typo in the version number and reformatted the How To Play page.

Most importantly, we changed the Privacy Policy to make it clear that there is a link the game store at the end of each chapter if you start off in the Demo.

notes.title: Update notes for 11 August 2021
notes.notes:
Emma's eyebrows were not changing colour when she was driving the cart in a left hand direction - girl, you have to change!

Also tried to make customisation instructions clearer: when you want to change the hero's appearance, you just go to the mirror, but when you want to change the appearance of the other hero, whose storyline you are not in, you go to the mirror and highlight their head beside the mirror.

notes.title: Update notes for 15 June 2021
notes.notes: Unbelievably, after all this time, there was a typo in one of the Prince speeches - thank you, Kristian Leadbeater, for pointing this out.  Also altered a soldier who shrank too much, made the ghost prince disappear and slowed some trees down.
